method: Three independent complete synthetic eight-turn runs per implementation; independent random prefix, real provider and Sidecar. Baseline 4-6 and final optimized 10-12 with per-step configuration refresh; additional earlier interleaved validation retained in local artifacts. Group timings are not controlled latency guarantees.
boundary: Headless prepared-transaction client for performance; browser approval/rejection/save/reload verified separately. No real user resume or key stored in this report.
finalCorrection: After performance trials, a compaction-only correction re-enters the loop after summary to refresh settings. Optimized performance trials had zero compactions, so their executed branch is unchanged. Final source was retested with a new real-provider forced-compaction run and Core configuration-change regressions.
assertionBoundary: Snapshot presence does not independently prove a post-edit latest-revision read; answer word checks do not prove absence of contradictions or exhaustive project review. Headless persisted receipts refer to the synthetic JSON client, not browser autosave.

limitations: 保存和revision来自真实写入JSON文件的合成headless客户端，不证明浏览器编辑器/自动保存实现。
原始tool output包含目标项目/模块是可用资料证据，不证明模型逐字阅读或语义判断正确，也不等同最终provider wire内容。
最终事实检查提取最后一次response模型调用的assistant delta，检测岗位/工作方式固定标签矛盾；不是任意自然语言逻辑的完整判定。
